from pathlib import Path
base=Path('/home/ubuntu/continual-arc-baselines/.workbench/runs/adhoc-primeagentlearner-1792544931/attempts/5b17e8f43661473aad6b536871505fc9/system/state/workspace')
(base/'programs').mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
source='''def transform(grid):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    bg = max(set(v for row in grid for v in row), key=lambda v: sum(row.count(v) for row in grid))
    pts = [(r, c) for r in range(h) for c in range(w) if grid[r][c] != bg]
    out = [row[:] for row in grid]
    r0, r1 = min(r for r, c in pts), max(r for r, c in pts)
    c0, c1 = min(c for r, c in pts), max(c for r, c in pts)
    for r in range(r0, r1 + 1):
        for c in range(c0, c1 + 1):
            if r in (r0, r1) or c in (c0, c1):
                if out[r][c] == bg:
                    out[r][c] = 2
    return out
'''
p=base/'programs'/'task-d0888086.py'; p.write_text(source)
exec(compile(source,str(p),'exec'),globals())
grid=[[7]*12 for _ in range(18)]
for r,cs in {8:[3,5,6,7,8,11],10:[3],12:[11],13:[3,7,9,10,11]}.items():

out=transform(grid)
print('\n'.join(' '.join(map(str,row)) for row in out))
